title: Installment Payment Terms by Patient Payment Plan Tier
content:
The tiers of the Patient Payment Plan differ in how installments are paid and how money received is treated. This chart gives each tier's setting for automatic payment, retries of a failed automatic payment, HSA and FSA cards, amounts above the installment due, later payer payments and part-payment of an installment.

## Chart

| Tier | Installments must be paid by automatic payment | Calendar days before a failed automatic payment is retried | Retries before the installment is treated as unpaid | HSA or FSA cards accepted for installments |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | No | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 3 | 2 | Yes |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 3 | 2 | Yes |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | No | 3 | 2 | Yes |

| Tier | Amount above the installment due | A later payer payment on an enrolled charge reduces the plan balance | Share of an installment that, paid by the end of the grace period, keeps it from counting as missed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | Applied to principal (reduces the balance) | Yes | 100 percent |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | Applied to principal (reduces the balance) | Yes | 100 percent |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | Applied to principal (reduces the balance) | Yes | 100 percent |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | Applied to principal (reduces the balance) | Yes | 100 percent |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | Applied to principal (reduces the balance) | Yes | 100 percent |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | Applied to principal (reduces the balance) | Yes | 50 percent |

## Points of judgement

- **Part-payment.** On five tiers an installment is kept from counting as missed only when 100 percent of it is paid by the end of the grace period. On the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan the figure is 50 percent: a hypothetical installment of 40.00 needs at least 20.00 paid by then, and 19.99 falls short.
- **Retries.** Every tier retries a failed automatic payment 3 calendar days later; the Short-Term, Standard and Extended tiers retry once, the Long-Term, Large-Balance and Hardship tiers twice.
- **Amounts above what is due.** On every tier they are applied to principal and reduce the balance.
